verses.text: وَجَّهْتْ وَجْهِى لَهُ عَبْدًا لَّهُ أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: wajjahtu wajhii lahu habdan lahu abadan
zaa khidmatin lirasuulil laahi kal kubaraa

verses.text: أُهْدِى لَهُ بِهَدَا يَاالْمَدْحُ نَا فِلَةً
verses.transcription: uhdii lahu bihadaa yal madhu naa filatan
wa bis salaati bihubit yuurisul kibaraa

verses.text: لَهُ عَلَىَّ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ لَا لِلَغًى
verses.transcription: lahu halayya liwajhil laahi laa lilaghan
duyuunu madhin taziidus sabqa wal mumuraa

verses.text: قَلِبْ قُلُوبَ الْعِدَى يَارَبِّ فِى عُمُرِى
verses.transcription: qalib quluubal hidaa yaa rabbi fii humurii
linusratii wal tarud lii jumlatal umaraa
halayhi salli wa sallim bil kiraami wa hab

verses.text: بِهِ لِىَ الْأَمْنَ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ وَالْبُشَرَا
verses.transcription: bihi liyal amna fid daarayni wal busharaa

verses.text: دَعَوْتُكَ الْيَوْمَ سَخِّى لِى الْعِدَى أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: dahawtukal yawma sakhkhii lil hidaa abadan

verses.text: رُضْ لِى اللَّعِينَ وَرَضْ لِى الْجِنَّ وَالْبَشَرَا
verses.transcription: rud lil lahiina wa rud lil jinna wal basharaa

verses.text: تَرَكْتُ فِى رَجَبٍ مَّا أَنْتَ تَعْلَمُهُ
verses.transcription: taraktu fii rajabin maa anta tahlamuhu
faltakfiniihaa wa hab lil aaya was suwara

verses.text: هَبْ لِى قُعُودًا بِمَا تَرْضَاهُ مِنْ عَمَلٍ
verses.transcription: hab lii quhudan bimaa tardaahu min hamalin

verses.text: أَبْقَيْتَ لِى الْعُمْرَ يَامَنْ أَحْسَنَ الصُّوَرَا
verses.transcription: abqayta lil humra yaa man ahsanas suwaraa

bayts.text: ذَلَّتْ لِعِزَّةِ رَبٍّ أَنْزَلَ السُّوَرَا ۞ جَمَاعَةُ الْخَلِقْ وَهْوَ الْمُحْسِنُ الصُّوَرَا

translations.it.karamati: Si è umiliata davanti alla potenza di un Signore che ha fatto discendere le sure la moltitudine del creato; ed Egli è Colui che rende belle le forme.
translations.en.karamati: The multitude of creation has humbled itself before the might of a Lord Who sent down the sūras; and He is the One Who makes forms beautiful.
translations.fr.karamati: S'est humiliée devant la puissance d'un Seigneur qui a fait descendre les sourates la multitude de la création ; et Il est Celui qui rend belles les formes.

bayts.text: وَجَّهْتْ وَجْهِى لَهُ عَبْدًا لَّهُ أَبَدًا ۞ ذَاخِدْمَةٍ لِّرَسُولِ اللَّهِ كَالْكُبَرَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho rivolto il mio volto a Lui, servo Suo per sempre, dotato di servizio all'Inviato di Allah, come i grandi.
translations.en.karamati: I have turned my face to Him, His slave forever, possessed of service to the Messenger of Allah, like the great ones.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai tourné ma face vers Lui, Son serviteur à jamais, doté de service envers l'Envoyé d'Allah, comme les grands.

bayts.text: أُهْدِى لَهُ بِهَدَا يَاالْمَدْحُ نَا فِلَةً ۞ وَبِالصَّلَاةِ بِحُبِتْ يُورِثُ الْكِبَرَا

translations.it.karamati: Gli offro con doni l'elogio supererogatorio, e con la benedizione, con un amore che fa ereditare la grandezza.
translations.en.karamati: I offer him with gifts supererogatory praise, and with blessing, with a love that bequeaths greatness.
translations.fr.karamati: Je Lui offre par des dons l'éloge surérogatoire, et par la bénédiction, avec un amour qui fait hériter la grandeur.

bayts.text: لَهُ عَلَىَّ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ لَا لِلَغًى ۞ دُيُونُ مَدْحٍ تَزِيدُ السَّبْقَ وَالْمُمُرَا

translations.it.karamati: Egli ha su di me, per il Volto di Allah, non per vanità, debiti di elogio che accrescono il primato e le vie (verso il bene).
translations.en.karamati: He has upon me, for the Countenance of Allah, not for vanity, debts of praise that increase precedence and the ways (to good).
translations.fr.karamati: Il a sur moi, pour la Face d'Allah, non par vanité, des dettes d'éloge qui accroissent la primauté et les passages (vers le bien).

bayts.text: قَلِبْ قُلُوبَ الْعِدَى يَارَبِّ فِى عُمُرِى ۞ لِنُصْرَتِى وَلْتَرُضْ لِى جُمْلَةَ الْأُمَرَا

translations.it.karamati: Volgi i cuori dei nemici, o Signore, nella mia vita, al mio soccorso, e doma per me l'insieme degli emiri.
translations.en.karamati: Turn the hearts of the enemies, O Lord, in my lifetime, to my support, and tame for me all the emirs.
translations.fr.karamati: Retourne les cœurs des ennemis, ô Seigneur, dans ma vie, vers mon secours, et dompte pour moi l'ensemble des émirs.

bayts.text: عَلَيْهِ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ بِالْكِرَامِ وَهَبْ ۞ بِهِ لِىَ الْأَمْنَ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ وَالْبُشَرَا

translations.it.karamati: Benedicilo e dona pace, con i nobili, e donami per mezzo di lui la sicurezza nelle due Dimore e le buone novelle.
translations.en.karamati: Bless him and grant peace, with the noble, and grant me through him safety in the two Abodes and glad tidings.
translations.fr.karamati: Bénis-le et accorde la paix, avec les nobles, et accorde-moi par lui la sécurité dans les deux Demeures et les bonnes nouvelles.

bayts.text: دَعَوْتُكَ الْيَوْمَ سَخِّى لِى الْعِدَى أَبَدًا ۞ رُضْ لِى اللَّعِينَ وَرَضْ لِى الْجِنَّ وَالْبَشَرَا

translations.it.karamati: Ti ho invocato oggi: sottometti per me i nemici per sempre, doma per me il Maledetto e doma per me i jinn e gli uomini.
translations.en.karamati: I have called upon You today: subject the enemies to me forever, tame the Accursed for me and tame the jinn and men for me.
translations.fr.karamati: Je T'ai invoqué aujourd'hui : soumets-moi les ennemis à jamais, dompte pour moi le Maudit et dompte pour moi les djinns et les hommes.

bayts.text: تَرَكْتُ فِى رَجَبٍ مَّا أَنْتَ تَعْلَمُهُ ۞ فَلْتَكْفِنِيهَا وَهَبْ لِى الْئَاىَ وَالسُّوَرَ

translations.it.karamati: Ho lasciato in Rajab ciò che Tu sai: risparmiamelo dunque, e donami i versetti e le sure.
translations.en.karamati: I left in Rajab what You know: so spare me it, and grant me the verses and the sūras.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai laissé en Rajab ce que Tu sais : épargne-le-moi donc, et accorde-moi les versets et les sourates.

bayts.text: هَبْ لِى قُعُودًا بِمَا تَرْضَاهُ مِنْ عَمَلٍ ۞ أَبْقَيْتَ لِى الْعُمْرَ يَامَنْ أَحْسَنَ الصُّوَرَا

translations.it.karamati: Donami lo star seduto con l'opera di cui Ti compiaci: hai fatto permanere per me la vita, o Tu che hai reso belle le forme.
translations.en.karamati: Grant me to sit (in devotion) with the deeds that please You: You have made life abide for me, O You Who made forms beautiful.
translations.fr.karamati: Accorde-moi le fait de rester assis avec l'œuvre dont Tu Te satisfais : Tu as fait demeurer pour moi la vie, ô Toi qui as rendu belles les formes.
